items.title: 트럼프, 이란 협상 시한 하루 연장…“7일 밤까지” - 한겨레

summaries.ko: 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이란에 제시한 호르무즈 해협 개방 시한을 하루 연장해 7일 밤까지로 미루면서 협상 진전 가능성을 언급하는 동시에 강력한 경고를 보냈다.
summaries.en: U.S. President Trump has extended Iran's deadline to open the Strait of Hormuz by one day, until Tuesday evening, stating the possibility of negotiation progress while also issuing strong threats.
summaries.zh: 美国总统特朗普将伊朗开放霍尔木兹海峡的最后期限延长了一天至周二晚，他在提及谈判进展可能性的同时，也发出了强硬警告。

summaries.en: President Lee Jae-myung has instructed officials to consider providing humanitarian aid to Iran as a way to retrieve 26 South Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz.

summaries.en: The Democratic Party's Supreme Council has recommended strong measures, including disqualification, against Gwangyang mayoral preliminary candidate Park Seong-hyun to the Jeonnam Provincial Party Election Commission, following an MBC report on his alleged unregistered campaign office.
summaries.zh: 民主党最高委员会根据MBC报道的“未注册竞选办公室疑云”，建议全南道党选举管理委员会对光阳市长预备候选人朴成贤采取包括取消资格在内的强力措施。
